body:
With SilkyPix 12 you get the same bad result as in the other programs.
When I make pictures of my plants and flowers it gets worse, except for SilkyPix8SE. Even when using a grey card for white balance the colors are wrong. And it's nearly impossible to get them right. Everything gets a yellowish tint, When I correct the colors in the middle of the histogram, dark and white get worse and so on. Sharpness is not good.
I really thought that the camera was bad but with SilkyPix 8 everything is perfect. The white balance info from the camera is correct, the plants look green insted of yellowish, full shapness and no noise. Even a picture with ISO 12800 becomes usable, not perfect of course.
